title: Headship of Christ
definition: The headship of Christ means that Jesus is the supreme authority, source, and ruler of His Church.
summary: Christ is the head of the Church and Lord over His people.
christFocus: Jesus loves, leads, nourishes, corrects, and rules His Church as its living Head.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
The Church does not belong to pastors, traditions, personalities, or culture. It belongs to Christ. He is its Head.

As Head, Christ rules His Church by His Word, gives life to His body, appoints gifts, corrects sin, and directs mission.

His headship protects the Church from human pride and calls every ministry under His authority.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: Churches can drift when human preference or personality replaces Christ's authority. The headship of Christ matters because the Church must remain under Him.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Submit church life and personal discipleship to Christ's authority. Ask whether ministry decisions honor the Head of the Church.
